QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: correctionSource
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Automatic selects one fresh stream for vehicles, preferring the local base station, then NTRIP, then UDP. Manual selection never falls back to another source category. All forwards every fresh stream and may mix base stations. NTRIP UDP forwarding is independent.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Vehicle correction source

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: correctionSourceInstance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Leave empty to choose a fresh stream within the selected source category. A specific endpoint remains pinned when unavailable, without fallback to another stream.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Correction stream

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtcmUdpInputEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Listen on a UDP port for incoming RTCM3 correction data and forward it to connected vehicles via MAVLink GPS_RTCM_DATA.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Enable UDP RTCM input

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtcmUdpInputPort
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: UDP port to listen on for incoming RTCM3 correction data.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: UDP RTCM input port

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: rtcmUdpValidate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Enable validation of incoming data as RTCM and drop garbage (improves security).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: UDP RTCM enable validation
